result.reason: The redline appropriately adds USD 5M cyber/privacy coverage and retains statutory workers’ compensation and evidence of coverage on request. The USD 1M E&O limit is within the stated fallback. However, the general liability coverage still lacks the required USD 1M per-occurrence and USD 2M aggregate limits, so the operative language does not reach even the fallback playbook position. The margin comment does not cure that omission. The amendment is otherwise targeted and preserves unrelated commercial terms, though using the playbook’s defined “Customer Data” terminology would be more precise.
